ITEM 1 | Bright red watermelon-like pieces, juicy and moist with a smooth flesh surface, cut into irregular wedges about 3-4 cm long and 1-2 cm thick, clustered in the upper-left of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow pineapple-like chunks with a matte, slightly fibrous flesh, cut into rectangular cubes about 2-3 cm per side, lying in a loose group at the lower-center of the plate | 95
ITEM 3 | Golden-brown cooked cubes with browned, slightly caramelized edges and a firm, dense interior, roughly 2-3 cm pieces, some with darker charred patches, piled in the right half of the plate | 150
ITEM 4 | Pale tan, crisp-edged roasted chunks with a lightly glossy, slightly oily sheen and some darker browned spots, about 2-3 cm, mixed with the cubes on the right side of the plate | 60
